nodes.name: Google Calendar: create/update event
nodes.notes: operation/start/end/recurrence are set FROM the item's own fields (existingEventId from 'Diff vs. previously synced events', recurrence from ShiftFit's publish request — see PublishRecurrence in src/services/automation/contracts.ts). The exact parameter names (operation, eventId, additionalFields.recurrence) depend on your n8n Google Calendar node version — check them against your instance before relying on this; it has never been run live. Items without $json.recurrence mean no semester dates were configured when ShiftFit built the request, which the frontend now prevents (SaveShareDialog requires saved semester dates before 'Approve and send' is enabled) — if you see one anyway, skip it rather than sending a dateless event.

meta.note: Starting-point template only — not a tested workflow. No real credentials included. See docs/N8N_ARCHITECTURE.md Workflow C. The shiftId->googleEventId idempotency map now uses n8n's own workflow static data, so it works out of the box for a pilot with no external database — see the notes on 'Diff vs. previously synced events' and 'Persist sync state'.
